premises.text: Diabetes management is hard because many life factors affect blood sugar, and existing apps only add manual logging and analysis work
premises.evidence_span: all they do is provide us with fancy tools so that we can do hard work of logging details and then manually analyzing them or sharing them

premises.text: Spike automatically collects routine, activity, and vitals data and proactively gives insulin tips, reminders, and food suggestions
premises.evidence_span: By automatically collecting details about your life, your routine, your activity, and your vitals, Spike proactively provides you with the right insulin tips and reminders with food suggestions

premises.text: Connected glucometers and patches feed readings, and guardians and doctors get real-time alerts on unusual patterns
premises.evidence_span: they are informed in real time about her situation

premises.text: The app is free for diabetics and paid for by insurers, self-insured employers, and others who value productivity
premises.evidence_span: spike is free forever for diabetics

value.text: Less-worry diabetes management that acts before incidents happen
value.evidence_span: We changed it from more work to less worry

causal_links.evidence_span: Living with diabetes is incredibly difficult
the problem lies before the incident happens, not after it
insurance companies Self-insured employers and many others who want to enhance your productivity
